key_insight: SCOPED separates capability-specific RL experts from a unified student, using reward-guided skill extraction and on-policy distillation to reduce cross-task interference while preserving specialized visual reasoning.
engineering_relevance: For building stronger vision-language systems, SCOPED offers a practical training recipe for combining independently learned skills into one deployable model without exposing explicit skills at inference time.
method: Train separate experts for different visual capabilities to avoid gradient conflict.
Extract explicit skills from expert trajectories via reward-guided reflection.
Distill expert behavior into a unified student using skill-augmented on-policy supervision, then remove skills at inference.
evidence_signal: Across eight multimodal benchmarks, SCOPED consistently outperforms the backbone model and mixed-capability RL baselines.
watch_item: The approach depends on reliable reward signals and skill extraction, so noisy rewards or poorly designed reflections could propagate bias or reduce transfer quality.
paper_title: Skill-Decoupled On-Policy Expert Distillation for Unified Vision-Language Models
